blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Air quality in Metro Cebu improved slightly on Monday, September 21, but remained at “very unhealthy” levels. Fine particles continued to linger in the air, the Environmental Management Bureau in Central Visayas (EMB-7) said. As of 4 p.m. Monday, EMB-7 recorded an air quality index (AQI) of 167 for PM2.5, keeping Metro Cebu within the “very unhealthy” category. The improvement came after PM2.5 concentrations spiked beginning September 19, when Metro Cebu recorded its highest levels during the ongoing transboundary haze episode.
